about_the_game:
Take flight as Juno, a small bird guided by the sound of her guitar through a hand-drawn world of music and memory.
Each melody you play shapes the world around you — revealing paths, setting the tone, and uncovering the story of a love that endures beyond silence.

Each level has its own song, it's own theme... its own mixtape.

Wearing her mother’s old headphones, Juno listens to songs recorded on a tape machine, where each track is a fragment of her “mixtape,” and each one a playable world. By rewinding the tapes, you bring these memories back to life while discovering the truth behind them.

Use it to explore the layers of a whimsical world and guide Juno through musical puzzles that blend melody with motion.

Move freely through the air as Juno, gliding and soaring across different landscapes. Each environment blends gentle platforming and exploration, inviting you to navigate through rhythm, motion, and light in a way that feels like flying inside a song.

Scattered across the world are ancient Sun Shrines, silent and forgotten. By awakening them, you bring the rain back to the world, healing the land and slowing a sky that seems forever in a rush for tomorrow.

Each shrine you restore draws you closer to understanding what was lost… and what can still return.

☀️ Features

  • 🎨 Hand-drawn 2D art and animation

  • 🪩 Original soundtrack and tape-based song mechanic

  • 🎮 Captivating platforming and creative puzzle-solving.

  • 🌅 A heartfelt story about grief, memory, and love

name: Tomorrowness

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for handheld PCs such as the Steam Deck and ROG Ally.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for handheld PCs such as the Steam Deck and ROG Ally.
